title: Lifeguards, Ski Patrol, and Other Recreational Protective Service Workers
description: Monitor recreational areas, such as pools, beaches, or ski slopes, to provide assistance and protection to participants.

projection.title: Lifeguards, ski patrol, and other recreational protective service workers

tasks.text: Patrol or monitor recreational areas, such as trails, slopes, or swimming areas, on foot, in vehicles, or from towers.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Patrolling natural areas is physical mobile work

dwas.name: Patrol natural areas to ensure safety or enforce regulations.

tasks.text: Rescue distressed persons, using rescue techniques and equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Rescue requires physical presence in hazardous environments

tasks.text: Contact emergency medical personnel in case of serious injury.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency request requires live accountable action

dwas.name: Request emergency personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Examine injured persons and administer first aid or cardiopulmonary resuscitation, if necessary, using training and medical supplies and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Administering first aid requires physical intervention

tasks.text: Warn recreational participants of inclement weather, unsafe areas, or illegal conduct.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Warning individuals is live, relational, accountable

dwas.name: Warn individuals about rule violations or safety concerns.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Maintain quality of pool water by testing chemical levels.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cleanliness inspection is physical and on-site

tasks.text: Complete and maintain records of weather and beach conditions, emergency medical treatments performed, and other relevant incident information.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Instruct participants in skiing, swimming, or other recreational activities and provide safety precaution information.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Training content AI-assisted; live instruction and demonstration human

tasks.text: Inspect recreational equipment, such as rope tows, T-bars, J-bars, or chair lifts, for safety hazards and damage or wear.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Hands-on safety inspection of physical equipment

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to ensure safety or proper functioning.

tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cleanliness inspection is physical and on-site

tasks.text: Observe activities in assigned areas, using binoculars, to detect hazards, disturbances, or safety infractions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Environmental hazard detection needs physical sensors

dwas.name: Observe individuals' activities to gather information or compile evidence.
Monitor environmental conditions to detect hazards.

tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Vessel operation requires real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Operate ships or other watercraft.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Provide assistance with staff selection, training, and supervision.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live instruction and hands-on coaching require human presence

dwas.name: Train employees in proper work procedures.

tasks.text: Provide assistance in the safe use of equipment, such as ski lifts.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — In-person comfort and safety assurance

dwas.name: Assist customers to ensure comfort or safety.

tasks.text: Participate in recreational demonstrations to entertain resort guests.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Athletic competition is inherently human physical
